description: This file defines the SystemNotification entity class, which models system notifications within the sales management system. It includes fields for notification details, related merchant store and user info, and audit information. It is annotated for persistence with JPA.

classes.name: SystemNotification
classes.description: Entity class representing system notifications, with fields for notification details, associated merchant store and user, date range, and audit information.

methods.description: Returns the primary key of the notification.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a MerchantStore with the notification.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Associates a User with the notification.
